notes.title: Demo release notes
notes.content:
Today there is a small patch for the demo.

[list]
[*] updated how to play window to fit smaller screens
[*] fix an issue when sometimes traps could despawn on restart
[*] fix an issue when sometimes skills were missing at the end of a level after restart
[/list]

Thanks everyone for the support so far. Let us know if you are having any issues.

Regards
Mike
